Data & privacy

Journey progress, helium, skins and sound settings are saved in this browser. They are not cloud saves; clearing browser storage removes them.

Ranked flights

Starting a ranked flight creates a random browser identity in an essential cookie and assigns a public flyer name. Your best submitted gate count and points appear on the shared leaderboard. No email, real name or sign-in is requested. Please keep your assigned flyer name if you want friends to recognize your score.

Flight sessions expire after 24 hours and are cleaned up when new flights start. Best scores remain for this leaderboard season. Clearing cookies gives you a new identity; it does not remove the old public score. The service uses request IP addresses temporarily to limit excessive requests; the game does not store IP addresses in the leaderboard database. Cloudflare processes hosting requests under its own policies.

Ads

This release does not load an advertising network. Reward buttons work only when an approved provider is connected. This notice and any required consent flow must be updated before advertising is enabled.
